bio.name: Jheyson Saavedra
bio.description: I'm Data Analyst and Philosophy Student. I find patterns in chaos and turn them into decisions making systems easier to understand and harder to break.
bio.current: With a background in philosophy, I approach problems structurally: building dashboards, automations, and analytical frameworks that reduce uncertainty. Currently working at the intersection of CX operations, risk, and data, with a growing interest in deeper analytical work.
bio.background: I've been building and programming since I was a kid, driven by a curiosity for how systems behave. I'm also deeply drawn to space, probably because it's the ultimate reminder of how much there is to explore and understand.
